# ShippingMethods

The shipping method block in its four states: a grey box asking for the address, a skeleton while rates load, a grey box when the address cannot be shipped to, and the list of rates. Each change fades in and the height follows. Pair it with `useShippingRates`, which supplies `status` and `rates`.

[Live demo](https://gurfi1.github.io/react-shopify-style-checkout/#/blocks/shippingmethods)

## Usage

```tsx
const shipping = useShippingRates({ address, country, load: api.shippingRates });

<ShippingMethods
  status={shipping.status}
  rates={shipping.rates}
  value={shipping.selected}
  onChange={shipping.select}
/>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | `'empty' \| 'loading' \| 'none' \| 'ready'` | Which state to show. |
| `rates` | `ShippingRate[]` | { id, name, eta, price }. A price of 0 reads “FREE”. |
| `value / onChange` | `string \| null / (id) => void` | The chosen rate. |
| `name` | `string` | Shared name of the radios. Default "shipping". |
